scene: The valve screeches open, belching sparkling violet vapour across the rooftop.
picture: Side-scrolling flat rooftop view. Far left, a closed brass hatch in the floor. Left of centre, the player in burnt-orange jacket, beanie, and brass telescope steps back from the hissing valve at centre. Up high, a violet vapour cloud billows. Far right, a mechanical brass seagull roosts on the low roof ledge.
shown: a closed round roof hatch on the roof deck at the far left
a dense violet cloud swirling up high above the player
a fat mechanical seagull roosting peacefully on the ledge far right

variants.scene: Glittering purple steam hisses from the rusted pipe, swirling into the twilight sky.
A warm lavender cloud bursts upwards, raining soft sparks over the wet roof.
Gears whirr loudly as the wheel shoots sweet-smelling violet fog into the air.
